decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster builds directly on the firm's coolant management expertise, and its own R&D lets it interpret results and refine the product, so it stays.
The cleaning centrifuge extends the firm's established filtration and coolant cleaning knowledge, giving it strong absorptive capacity to improve and sell it.
The scraper belt chip conveyor sits close to the firm's core conveying business, so it can readily assimilate market feedback, and it has stayed visible on the website.
The hinged belt chip conveyor is a core conveying technology the firm knows well and supports with in-house R&D, so keeping it is the expected choice.
